reservoir_ep11_001.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep11_001.text: On Day One Thousand One Hundred Thirty-one, Yue took the confirmed carrier timetable to the public bench. The paper held two possible departures and neither could become harmless by being read again. An earlier home arrival would include the cousin's meal and cost two paid duties plus the attended plateau comparison. A later arrival would preserve those duties and meet her mother after the gathering had ended. Both visits had been welcomed. Yue had enough actually received money for either finite journey, and no money that could buy the same days twice.

reservoir_ep11_002.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep11_002.text: Fu sat beside her with an ordinary garden basket, which Tian would have criticized for its lack of ambition. Yue described the two absences rather than the two attractive promises. Fu said her brother had accepted the later song audience and had been practicing without accusing anybody of stealing his words. Yue would probably miss one rehearsal whichever road she chose. She felt a small pang at that ordinary consequence. Leaving the basin did not affect only examinations; people here had begun expecting her face at particular harmless moments.

reservoir_ep11_003.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep11_003.text: That afternoon Deng supervised one modest familiar lesson and retained its full stop. Yue noticed her attention drifting toward the road before he named it. She released, admitted the distraction and waited until she could attend to the room again. The teaching time had been purchased for a finite session, so the waiting did not authorize another hour. They completed fewer safe sets than she had hoped. Her family's offered days mattered enough to occupy her mind, and she would have to arrange practice around that actual occupation rather than pretend it never occurred.

reservoir_ep11_004.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep11_004.text: Jing asked whether Yue wanted the next independent comparison postponed until the visit choice was settled. Yue chose the registered current schedule because she felt recovered and could attend to its limited task. The decision did not make a distracted practice safe by declaration. Jing would still perform the accepted blank and actual sample under Mei's independent comparison. Yue went to bed early, leaving the timetable folded. She wanted the following morning's result to describe ordinary rest and attention rather than a night's repeated negotiation with dates.

reservoir_ep11_005.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep11_005.text: On Day One Thousand One Hundred Thirty-two, the accepted comparison measured seventy and a half usable before sampling. A quarter-unit sample left seventy and a quarter. Compatibility measured ninety-one and three quarters percent. Recorded safe intake and recovered practice supplied the modest gain since the prior result. The measured quantity still fell short of seventy-two, and the three changed conditions remained unpassed. Yue could welcome progress without offering it as a reason to cancel the journey's ordinary costs. A larger reserve would not restore a missed meal or perform a shift in her absence.

reservoir_ep11_006.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep11_006.text: The pump-village candidate heard about the possible visit and wished he could go home before his own next attempt. His journey would require a different carrier and money he had not yet received. Yue resisted offering him her contingency simply because she disliked the difference between them. That sum already protected her booked road once chosen. Instead she asked whether his teaching receiver had an actual ordinary absence process. He had not asked. They walked to its public desk, where he could request information without borrowing somebody else's finite reserve.

reservoir_ep11_007.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep11_007.text: The receiver explained his own course terms and offered a later available window. Yue did not stay for his private money discussion. Outside, she waited beneath the tree until he returned looking relieved and irritated in equal parts. The window was possible but not immediate. He thanked her for accompanying him to ask, then said he still hated waiting. Yue agreed that a useful answer could contain an unwelcome date. They bought no celebratory tea from money not in his purse. They walked back to the ordinary kitchen meal already covered by their courses.

reservoir_ep11_008.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep11_008.text: Day One Thousand One Hundred Thirty-three brought a storm warning for the lower bank. The public path would close if the ordinary observed conditions reached its threshold. Qiu moved the garden gathering to the covered courtyard instead of treating the weather as a test of anybody's resolve. Yue watched Fu's brother carry the low chairs while another ordinary worker fetched the higher lamp. Their separate tasks left no gap for an untested qi rescue. By evening the wind was loud, and the song began beneath a roof that had actually been checked.

reservoir_ep11_009.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep11_009.text: Fu's brother finished the whole song before Yue offered any response. She thanked him for its final line and asked whether he now wanted corrections. He said he wanted to keep the invented rhyme because the child who had coughed liked it. Yue accepted that decision. Her earlier apology had become a changed conversation, with his preference governing the song rather than her claim to know its proper words. Fu smiled over the ordinary bread bowl. The repair had required no glorious reconciliation, only a promise that had been carried through.

reservoir_ep11_010.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep11_010.text: The storm tightened while they ate. A loose outer cloth struck the courtyard post, and the ordinary attendant took it down before it became another flying basket. Tian protested that his basket had endured enough comparisons. Jing said the basket could request privacy when it learned to stay on the ground. Yue laughed and remained seated while the qualified workers handled the exposed fastening. A remembered accident did not appoint her to catch every new object. The familiar safe shoulder range remained valuable precisely because she did not abandon it for the joke.

reservoir_ep11_011.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep11_011.text: On Day One Thousand One Hundred Thirty-four, the storm left two shallow pools beside the garden beds. Jing's father examined the beans and blamed the weather with no expectation that it would apologize. Fu and her brother cleared the ordinary drainage notch under its actual work arrangement. Yue watched from the dry path and asked the father about the plum tree's rent note. He said a tree paid slowly and badly. She wrote that reply on a scrap for the later family visit, where her mother could decide whether its joke deserved repetition.

reservoir_ep11_012.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep11_012.text: Qiu confirmed that the reopened carrier route remained under ordinary inspection after the storm. A current timetable did not outrun the actual road. Yue could book by the acceptance deadline and still face a delay if conditions changed. The three-copper contingency existed for a finite real disruption, with a larger disruption requiring another paid plan rather than heroic speed. She knew that from the earlier journey. Hearing it again did not make her less eager to go home; it gave the eagerness a road that could exist outside her imagination.

reservoir_ep11_013.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep11_013.text: During the next modest lesson Deng asked Yue to choose a sentence about the visit before practicing a safe release. She said she wanted to arrive without promising a cure. The words surprised both of them with their directness. Deng accepted the sentence and returned to the familiar application, whose ceiling remained unchanged. Yue released at the ordinary signal and felt the desire to draw more recede after the stop. The technique did not remove her mother's old cost. It helped her remain a daughter able to hear that cost without inventing another bargain.

reservoir_ep11_014.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep11_014.text: At supper the squash-hating candidate asked what food Yue expected at home. Yue remembered a sour plum dish, a bean pot and bread whose ends her mother always broke for herself. She had no evidence all three would be served, but the memory made her hungry. The other woman described her village's thick onion cakes with such seriousness that Tian began taking notes for an imagined traveling kitchen. Yue told him to keep the recipe separate from the grain dates. He solemnly painted a tiny onion below the fish.

reservoir_ep11_015.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep11_015.text: Day One Thousand One Hundred Thirty-five was an ordinary free day. Yue mended the low fastening of her travel coat and checked the actual stitching of its shoulder seam. She would not carry the main road load on that shoulder. The carrier's accepted package service would hold her larger bundle, while she kept only the permitted light personal bag. Her own meals, fare and sleeping stops remained privately funded. Preparing an ordinary coat made the future journey tangible enough that she could stop searching the timetable for a third painless departure.

reservoir_ep11_016.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep11_016.text: Jing offered to help mend the seam and asked whether Yue feared returning changed. Yue said she feared returning unchanged after so much effort, then realized both fears had occupied the same chair. Her mother might recognize a daughter before recognizing any improvement. Jing said her father still asked whether she had eaten whenever she visited, regardless of her instrument qualifications. Yue laughed and admitted she hoped for that question. It would let her answer with a real meal instead of introducing herself through an unfinished reservoir examination.

reservoir_ep11_017.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep11_017.text: The mother had not asked to review a reserve trace, and Yue would take no borrowed apparatus home. Her permitted own notes could travel in the private folder. The sampling sleeves, ordinary comparison instruments and course materials would remain in Jing's custody. Yue packed the plum-tree drawing beside a clean writing sheet. She left the failed assessment copies with their proper record rather than carry a portfolio demanding family judgment. The visit would contain enough explanation without bringing the whole pavilion to sit at the mother's kitchen table.

reservoir_ep11_018.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep11_018.text: On Day One Thousand One Hundred Thirty-six, an ordinary basin receiver asked whether Yue would attend the specific plateau comparison scheduled for Fifty-two. Her answer depended on the forthcoming visit selection. She asked him to retain her possible place only until the published deadline, not indefinitely. The receiver agreed and named the qualified replacement procedure for the related paid duty. If Yue chose the earlier road, the replacement would be informed and paid for actual work. Her absence would close an opportunity rather than leave a conveniently empty chair for a later imagined appearance.

reservoir_ep11_019.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep11_019.text: The comparison concerned two ordinary basin records under their current permitted public scope. Attendance would let Yue hear the households' actual questions and the receivers' answers, not copy private factory components closed with the city term. That distinction had already been settled, and no one reopened it for a useful event. Yue wanted to hear the questions. She also wanted to hear the cousin describe the kiln-yard nickname they had invented as children. Both conversations were specific enough that losing either would remain recognizable after the journey.

reservoir_ep11_020.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep11_020.text: Fu asked whether Yue wanted her opinion about which window to select. Yue said yes, provided it came without a claim that everybody must make the same choice. Fu preferred the earlier family meal because she had once left a similar gathering until next year and then found its people scattered. That experience belonged to Fu's life, not a prophecy about Yue's cousin. Yue listened. She could take the warning seriously without turning an unchosen later visit into abandonment. Fu was relieved that her memory had been heard without acquiring authority it had not requested.

reservoir_ep11_021.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep11_021.text: Zhou offered a different opinion when Yue told him the dates. He valued the ordinary comparison because questions heard in person could change how a worker later recognized a misleading record. He also said Yue would not become a worse worker by missing it for an actual home visit. His own missed apple remained evidence that absence had ordinary costs, not a punishment. Yue appreciated the permission to choose without demanding that the experienced people agree. Their different preferences made the decision clearer rather than easier.

reservoir_ep11_022.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep11_022.text: Day One Thousand One Hundred Thirty-seven passed with reduced already-earned practice and an ordinary public walk. Yue's shoulder felt within its established condition, and she performed no new load test before the road. Deng reminded her that the journey's ordinary walking and light bag did not authorize cultivation work in a moving cart. She had no plan to attempt it. The carrier would not be asked to stop while she chased a reserve reading. She could travel as an ordinary passenger and return for fresh assessment before resuming the harder practice.

reservoir_ep11_023.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep11_023.text: At the bridge Tian showed her a paper boat with a fish painted on its bow. He intended to give it to the child who had lost the earlier boat. Yue asked whether the child wanted a fish. Tian admitted he had not asked. They found the child on the dry bank, where he requested a dragon instead. Tian sighed and drew an extremely fishlike dragon. The child accepted it enthusiastically. Yue watched the gift become more useful through one actual question, and thought of the low shelf she had nearly designed without its owner's voice.

reservoir_ep11_024.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep11_024.text: On Day One Thousand One Hundred Thirty-eight, the road receiver confirmed the two finite booking places remained available. The earlier outward fare would reserve departure Forty-three; the later would reserve Fifty-four. Each ordinary outward passage cost four coppers from Yue's private travel reserve. She could pay the selected fare on Forty-two and leave the remainder for its actual road and return costs. The return fare would be paid when the accepted return journey occurred, not charged a second time because a projected line looked complete. Yue wrote the actual payment timing beside the reserve.

reservoir_ep11_025.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep11_025.text: The course household confirmed her room could remain held through either finite absence. Actual unused daily meal reserves would return to the teaching source, and the room's one-copper daily holding charge would remain paid for a real retained place. Yue would buy the road's actual meals privately. At home her mother had offered the ordinary guest space while Yue contributed toward her own food. No helper was displaced from paid duties. The prospective visit changed the daughter's work calendar, not the mother's authority over the household.

reservoir_ep11_026.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep11_026.text: Jing asked what small thing Yue wanted to bring home. Yue had considered a costly useful gift and rejected it because she had not asked whether the household needed it. She chose instead to copy Tian's ridiculous fish and the river onion onto a clean scrap. Jing gave her one small embroidered bean leaf from her own scrap cloth, freely offered rather than cut from a paid preparation item. The gift had no practical burden. Yue put it beside the plum-tree drawing and hoped her mother would laugh before asking what the creature was.

reservoir_ep11_027.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep11_027.text: On Day One Thousand One Hundred Thirty-nine, Yue and the pump candidate walked the public bank after their separate modest lessons. He had accepted his own later ordinary home window and seemed calmer now that waiting had a particular date. Yue remained between hers. He said choosing a date had not removed his wish for another one. She found that strangely reassuring. A decision could end negotiation without ending regret. They watched the child's fish-dragon boat lodge in a harmless eddy until the child fetched it with an ordinary stick.

reservoir_ep11_028.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep11_028.text: The child's parent reminded him not to climb the slick edge. He obeyed after a disappointed look at the boat. Yue felt an old urge to recover the boat herself with a more impressive reach, though no one needed it. The urge passed when the child found a longer dry route and fetched it safely. She had begun recognizing how pride could disguise itself as generosity. The recognition did not prove she would never repeat the habit. It gave her one more ordinary moment in which somebody else's capable action was allowed to finish.

reservoir_ep11_029.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep11_029.text: At night Yue reread the cousin's short line in the mother's letter. The cousin hoped she would arrive for the meal, but understood that the carrier and course duties had actual dates. Yue had nearly translated that understanding into evidence the cousin would not mind an absence. It meant no such thing. The cousin could mind and still refuse to demand an impossible schedule. Yue wrote two honest possible replies. One promised attendance at the meal if the road allowed; the other acknowledged that she would miss it and visit afterward.

reservoir_ep11_030.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep11_030.text: Day One Thousand One Hundred Forty brought another modest accepted comparison. The actual usable starting quantity after rest and ordinary movement stood at seventy and three quarters. The quarter-unit sample left seventy and a half, with ninety-one and seven eighths percent compatibility. The recovered qualified practice had supplied recorded input within the old ceiling. Both criteria still fell short, and the changed-condition series remained failed. Yue could travel without pretending she had paused at the threshold of an already-earned stage. On return she would bring the body that actually arrived to fresh assessment.

reservoir_ep11_031.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep11_031.text: After the comparison, Deng asked Yue whether she wanted to attempt a changed condition immediately before travel. She declined because the registered recovered series had not yet been prepared and the road would add ordinary uncertainty to follow-up. He accepted that clear answer. The local certificate would wait for actual qualified trials and their next-day checks after her return. A family visit was not a method for increasing usable reserve. It was a finite ordinary journey whose demands belonged in the next starting assessment rather than outside the accounting of her body.

reservoir_ep11_032.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep11_032.text: On Day One Thousand One Hundred Forty-one, Yue put the light travel bag on the low table and removed half its contents. She had packed writing paper for every possible explanation and two garments she would not wear inside either finite window. The carrier would hold the larger accepted bundle, but there was no reason to fill it with anxiety. She retained ordinary clothing, her private permitted notes, the gifts and the road money. The embroidered bean leaf fitted beside the startled onion without needing another box.

reservoir_ep11_033.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep11_033.text: Fu helped check the coat's mended fastening and asked whether Yue wanted company at the booking desk tomorrow. Yue accepted. Having company would not transfer the choice to Fu, and Fu said she understood. She would also refuse to deliver a speech if Yue became quiet. The promise made them laugh. They had repaired one awkward conversation recently and could now specify a useful kind of help. Yue had once imagined friendship meant anticipating every need perfectly. Asking for the right finite thing seemed more practical and kinder to both women.

reservoir_ep11_034.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep11_034.text: Jing returned the private notes Yue had left at the receiving shelf and confirmed that no borrowed course instruments belonged in the travel bag. Yue had already left them behind. The statement became an ordinary final check rather than another argument about ownership. Jing then tucked the bean embroidery more securely into its paper fold. She wanted the mother to see the intended leaf, not a crumpled green mystery. Yue promised to report its reception if her mother wished to share it. The gift could be enjoyed without creating compulsory correspondence.

reservoir_ep11_035.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep11_035.text: That evening Zhou invited her to eat with the ordinary receiving workers one more time before either departure. Tian served beans and confessed that he had burned the first pot. The kitchen had paid for its own actual replacement from its ordinary food arrangement; he had not charged the loss to a candidate's material line. The confession saved a long theory about why the beans tasted smoky. Yue ate the second pot and asked whether the basket had approved its cargo. Tian said it preferred the smell of the first.

reservoir_ep11_036.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep11_036.text: Zhou raised his bowl and wished her an actual safe journey, without predicting its spiritual benefit. Yue thanked the workers for the useful ordinary shifts she had already completed. She would perform the later two only if she selected their dates and remained recovered for their tasks. Nobody toasted wages not yet received. The meal felt warm without requiring an advancement announcement. Yue looked around the table and realized that whichever road she chose would leave these ordinary faces here, continuing days she would later hear about secondhand.

reservoir_ep11_037.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep11_037.text: The next morning was One Thousand One Hundred Forty-two, the finite carrier acceptance deadline. Qiu gave Yue the current ordinary road check and confirmed that both places could still be booked. No new storm restriction had changed the route overnight. The course receiver had also prepared the replacement notice for the earlier absence and the retained-duty confirmation for the later. Yue took both papers to the low desk. This was the last morning on which she could keep them as equally open possibilities without inconveniencing an actual receiver.

reservoir_ep11_038.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep11_038.text: Before entering the desk room, Fu asked whether Yue wanted one final opinion. Yue said she wanted a quiet minute instead. Fu waited outside beneath the dry eave. Yue looked at the two drafts she had written to her mother. The earlier one promised the cousin's meal; the later one promised a quieter visit after completed work. Neither contained a cure or a claim that regret would vanish. She could now choose from actual welcomed dates, earned money and named missed opportunities, without making the unselected life unreal.

reservoir_ep11_039.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep11_039.text: The desk clerk placed two ordinary fare slips on the table. Each required four coppers for the selected outward passage. He asked for the date, not a justification of what daughters should value. Yue appreciated the plainness. An ordinary clerk could complete the booking without judging the cousin's meal or the plateau comparison. She set the private travel reserve beside the slips and kept the teaching purse closed elsewhere. The road would use her actually received money and her ordinary body, whichever date she spoke.

reservoir_ep11_040.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep11_040.text: Qiu reminded her that the choice would change actual duty notices immediately. An earlier departure released the two work dates and attended comparison to their qualified receivers. A later departure retained them and acknowledged the missed cousin gathering in the family confirmation. Yue would not be charged a penalty for either accepted selection. The cost lay in the real wages, conversation and time each option left behind. She had spent enough evenings wishing for a third date. Now the two available ones were waiting for her actual answer.

reservoir_ep11_041.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep11_041.text: Outside the eave, Fu's brother arrived carrying bread for the ordinary desk workers. He did not sing. Fu whispered that he had finally learned when an audience was busy. Yue heard the joke through the open door and smiled, then returned her attention to the clerk. The basin would keep supplying small changes after she left. She wanted to be present for all of them and could not. The mother's household would also keep moving. A visit meant entering part of that movement at one real time.

reservoir_ep11_042.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep11_042.text: Yue held the two drafts long enough to feel their different paper edges. She was not choosing whether her mother mattered; both accepted roads ended at the same ordinary home. She was choosing which particular work and family absence she would carry, and which conversation would actually be heard in person. Her earned small circuit would travel unchanged. The old lost years would remain lost. The clerk waited while she set one draft face-up and prepared to speak its departure date.

reservoir_visit_choice.speaker: narrator
reservoir_visit_choice.text: The earlier carrier leaves tomorrow and reaches home for four days, including the cousin's meal. It releases two paid duties and the attended plateau comparison to an actual replacement. The later carrier leaves after those duties and reaches home for five quieter days, after the gathering. Both visits have the mother's consent and a privately funded road. Yue can reserve only one outward place inside the accepted timetable. She looks from the fare slip to the chosen letter and names the life she will make room to attend.

choices.text: Take the earlier road and share the cousin's meal; release both paid duties and the attended comparison.
Stay for the paid duties and comparison; visit afterward and miss the cousin's gathering.

reservoir_visit_home.speaker: narrator
reservoir_visit_home.text: Yue named the departure on One Thousand One Hundred Forty-three. She would take the earlier road and arrive for the four home days beginning Fifty-two, including the cousin's meal on Fifty-four. The clerk accepted four coppers from the private travel reserve for the actual outward booking. It was the first fare payment, not an additional charge beyond the reserved eight for both directions. Yue watched him write the selected date. The other slip remained on the table, and its quieter later visit ceased to be her available journey.

reservoir_ep11_045.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep11_045.text: She signed the actual release of the two course duties on Fifty and Fifty-two. The receiver called the qualified replacement, who accepted both ordinary eight-hour equivalents under their established range. Their six coppers would go to that worker after actual completed duties. Yue would receive neither the wages nor authorship of the attended comparison on Fifty-two. The replacement thanked her for making the notice early enough to arrange the days. The gratitude did not erase the opportunity she had given up; it made the replacement a real person in that consequence.

reservoir_ep11_046.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep11_046.text: Qiu confirmed that Yue's actual absence would begin Forty-three and end with the ordinary return arrival on Sixty-four, twenty-two calendar days. The course bed remained held, while the twenty-two unused daily meal reserves would return to their source after actual attendance reconciliation. Yue would buy road food privately and contribute for her four actual home days. The qualified receiver would handle the comparison's public record. Yue could later read its permitted summary, but could not recover the questions heard in the room by calling the page her own attended observation.

reservoir_ep11_047.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep11_047.text: Fu joined her after the accepted signatures and asked whether she felt relieved. Yue said yes, and also felt the missed plateau morning beginning to hurt. Fu accepted both answers. Her own preference for the earlier gathering did not require Yue to celebrate every consequence. They went to inform Jing of the actual departure. Jing checked the private light bag and asked whether the embroidered leaf had survived. Yue showed it in its paper fold. The selected journey now carried a small ordinary gift and a real missing work date.

reservoir_ep11_048.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep11_048.text: At the ordinary courier desk Yue sent the earlier confirmation to her mother. The actual dispatch cost one copper from the uncommitted personal margin outside the fifty-two-copper travel ceiling. The letter named the booked departure, expected arrival and four home days, subject to actual road conditions. It acknowledged the two released duties without asking the mother to compensate for them. The mother had welcomed the window; she had not hired the daughter away from paid work. Yue also wrote that she looked forward to hearing the cousin's ridiculous kiln-smoke names again.

reservoir_ep11_049.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep11_049.text: Zhou heard the notice before supper and wished her safe ordinary travel. He would supervise the actual replacement on the released dates. Yue asked him to send no private worker gossip with the comparison's later permitted summary. He laughed and said she could ask Tian for a completely public basket report instead. The boundary amused them because it had become familiar enough to say once. Yue ate at the ordinary table knowing tomorrow's breakfast would begin her privately paid road, rather than another course meal billed from her absence.

reservoir_ep11_050.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep11_050.text: That evening she reduced the larger carrier bundle once more and checked its accepted light-bag limit. No sample instrument traveled with her, and no qi application had been cleared for the moving cart. The useful ordinary preparation consisted of warm clothes, road food money and an intact shoulder seam. She put the cousin's line beside the selected confirmation draft. The missed comparison had become an actual empty place she had released. She let herself mourn it briefly instead of trying to prove the family meal would be valuable enough to abolish the loss.

reservoir_ep11_051.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep11_051.text: Fu's brother came to the gate with the properly learned final song line. He said Yue would miss the next rehearsal, so he wanted her to hear that piece before she left. She asked whether he wanted correction afterward. He said no, only a farewell listener. She listened, thanked him and kept the promise. Fu looked pleased. The friendship's repaired condition had survived the pressure of departure. Yue could carry the tune home without claiming she had attended the later full performance that would happen while she was away.

reservoir_ep11_052.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep11_052.text: Before sleeping, Yue placed the paid outward fare acknowledgment in her private folder. Forty-eight remained inside the fifty-two-copper travel ceiling after that actual four-copper payment. The earlier journey's planned base costs would total forty-eight, with three reserved contingency and one spare within the larger ceiling if no disruption occurred. She did not spend those future lines tonight. Her stage remained seven, her family visit remained ordinary, and tomorrow she would leave the basin in time to share a gathering that could not wait for her later certificate.

reservoir_visit_work.speaker: narrator
reservoir_visit_work.text: Yue placed the later confirmation face-up and named departure on One Thousand One Hundred Fifty-four. The clerk accepted four actual coppers from her private travel reserve for that outward place. She would reach home for the five quieter days beginning Sixty-three, after the cousin's meal had ended. The selected fare belonged within the reserved eight for both directions. Yue watched the earlier slip return to the clerk's stack. Tomorrow's road would leave without her, and the gathering she had hoped to share would happen while she remained in the basin.

reservoir_ep11_054.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep11_054.text: She signed the actual retention of the two ordinary course duties on Fifty and Fifty-two. Their six-copper wages remained payable only after she completed the accepted eight-hour equivalents while recovered for their established tasks. The plateau comparison on Fifty-two retained her attended place under its current permitted public scope. The qualified replacement was told those two duties had not been released. That worker could arrange other days rather than wait for a vacancy Yue had not chosen. Her decision changed real notices before it changed any balance of received money.

reservoir_ep11_055.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep11_055.text: Qiu recorded the selected absence from Fifty-four through the ordinary return arrival on Seventy-six, twenty-three calendar days. The modest course bed would remain held for that actual interval. Twenty-three unused daily meal reserves would return to their source after attendance reconciliation; no such money would become a private road allowance. Yue's own reserve would pay travel food and five home-day meal contributions. The cousin's gathering had no replacement seat in that later calendar. A quieter visit was an actual different visit, not the earlier meal performed again for her convenience.

reservoir_ep11_056.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep11_056.text: Fu asked whether Yue wanted to speak about the missed gathering before discussing work. Yue said she did. She had chosen the attended comparison, but the cousin's kiln-smoke names would be told to other listeners on Fifty-four. Fu did not call the choice cold or pretend the gathering was unimportant. She said Yue could write that she was sorry to miss it without asking the cousin to declare the absence painless. The advice gave Yue a sentence she could send that afternoon, along with the actual accepted travel date.

reservoir_ep11_057.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep11_057.text: The ordinary courier accepted the later confirmation after Yue paid one copper from the uncommitted personal margin outside the fifty-two-copper travel ceiling. The letter named the booked departure, expected arrival and five home days, subject to actual road conditions. It acknowledged the missed cousin meal and explained the two real duties she had retained. She asked for no repeated gathering and promised no practical cure. Her mother had welcomed this later window too. Yue wrote that she hoped to hear about the meal when its people wished to tell her.

reservoir_ep11_058.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep11_058.text: Zhou confirmed the two retained low-table duties and asked her to report any actual change in recovery before their dates. Yue agreed. She had not purchased those wages by choosing their schedule; she still needed to perform the work. The comparison receiver confirmed the attended place under its permitted public scope. No city factory privilege reopened with it. Yue would hear ordinary household questions and actual source explanations that could improve her later recognition of a misleading record. The useful opportunity remained particular enough that she could name why she had stayed.

reservoir_ep11_059.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep11_059.text: At supper Tian offered to organize a substitute cousin meal in the basin. Yue thanked him for the affection and declined the substitute. She could enjoy a basin supper without pretending the absent household had been reproduced around its table. Tian accepted that and proposed ordinary beans instead. They ate with Fu and Jing after their actual shifts. Yue let herself feel pleased to remain among these faces for twelve more days and sad that her cousin's gathering would proceed without her. Neither feeling needed the other removed before she could swallow the bread.

reservoir_ep11_060.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep11_060.text: She left the packed carrier bundle at the ordinary holding shelf and kept her work clothes ready for the retained dates. The outward booking was paid, with forty-eight remaining inside the fifty-two-copper travel ceiling for its actual other costs and contingency. Her present stage remained the small circuit. A larger future usable reserve would not explain away the family's missed earlier conversation. Yue placed the selected letter draft beside the plum-tree drawing and imagined the quieter kitchen in which she would hear the mother's current ordinary concerns after the gathering had ended.

reservoir_ep11_061.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep11_061.text: Fu's brother invited her to the next actual rehearsal because she would still be here. Yue accepted only the part outside her posted practice and work intervals. He asked her to listen through the whole song before responding, and she renewed that promise. The decision had preserved a real basin evening as well as paid duties. It had also lost a real family evening. Yue went to bed with both facts intact, preparing to remain for work she had chosen rather than wait passively for a carrier that would arrive after the earlier home meal.

reservoir_ep11_062.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep11_062.text: The accepted fare slip and courier acknowledgment now described one real departure. Yue kept them in the private folder while the clerk filed the unselected place for another traveler. Her mother would receive the actual confirmation through its ordinary route. The cousin could choose how to feel about the dates without controlling them. The course receiver had the correct duty notice, and the carrier had the selected outward fare. A decision had become several people's usable information rather than remain a private argument inside Yue's room.

reservoir_ep11_063.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep11_063.text: Jing's embroidered leaf, Tian's river creature and the plum-tree drawing fitted together inside the light bag. Yue looked at those ridiculous and tender objects before closing it. None restored the mother's lost years or increased the reservoir's usable inventory. They were things a daughter could bring because she had lived through days worth describing. The upcoming journey would carry an actual ordinary body with its old shoulder limits and an unfinished examination. At home that body would sit in a chair and hear what the mother wanted to say.

reservoir_ep11_064.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep11_064.text: Beyond the gate, the basin's surface darkened beneath the first evening wind. Yue had given up one of the two possible calendars, and the loss would remain visible when the missed day arrived. The selected road was now funded and booked. Its actual walking, sleeping stops and home conversations still lay ahead; they could not be replaced by a cheerful declaration that the visit had happened. She folded the remaining private coins into their road divisions and prepared to carry the chosen work and absence into the next real morning.

reservoir_ep11_065.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep11_065.text: Deng left a short return instruction at the ordinary desk: report the actual journey and current recovery before another practice load. Yue read it once and placed it beside her permitted notes. The examination would resume from the body that returned, not a remembered quantity packed into the bag. She closed the private folder.
